checkHealthConnect.realDataNote: Repository/Jira fields below are pre-filled from this project's saved connection — credentials are never stored, so re-enter the token/password and click Connect to run a real scan.
checkHealthConnect.noJiraSourceWarning: This project's tickets aren't connected via Jira (they came from an Excel upload), so it can't be re-run live from this page — use the Check Health Upload page to re-scan it with a fresh Excel file instead.
checkHealthConnect.excelSourceNoLiveRerun: This project's tickets came from an Excel upload, not Jira — re-running it live isn't supported here. Go to the Check Health Upload page to re-scan with a fresh Excel file.
checkHealthConnect.gitDescription: Connect directly to a Git repo to get the source for this check. Supports a Personal Access Token, or a username + password for self-hosted Git servers that require real account credentials. Scans actual source code from a path in this repo (excluding any 'docs' folder), and optionally also fetches documentation files (README, specs) from a separate path as extra context for the AI evaluation.
checkHealthConnect.jiraDescription: Fetch the ticket list directly from Jira for this check. Works with both Jira Cloud (email + API Token) and self-hosted Jira Server/Data Center (username + password, or a Personal Access Token as the password). These credentials are only used to test the connection and are never stored.
checkHealthConnect.saveSnapshot: Save as a new snapshot for the Trend chart
checkHealthConnect.evaluatingWithAiDeepDive: Evaluating with AI (deep-dive agent may take a while)...
checkHealthConnect.deepDiveLabel: Deep-dive with AI agent (slower, more accurate)
checkHealthConnect.deepDiveHelp: For tickets left Incomplete or low-confidence, clones the repo locally and lets an AI agent browse the real code (search, read files, trace references) before giving a final verdict. Takes longer and costs more per ticket than the standard scan.
checkHealthConnect.forceFullReevaluateHelp: By default, a ticket that was a Match last time is skipped (no AI call) as long as its status/content and the repo's commit haven't changed since -- saving time and tokens. Check this to bypass that and re-run AI on every ticket regardless.

modelConfig.title: Model Configuration
modelConfig.subtitle: Configure which LLM (API key, base URL, model name) the app uses for ticket evaluation, deep-dive, and solution synthesis — no backend restart needed after saving.

modelConfig.phase1Description: Used for the fast/cheap first evaluation pass on every ticket, and for Solution Management's project-wide recommendations.
modelConfig.phase2Description: Used for the deep-judgment re-check of flagged tickets, and for the Layer 4 tool-calling agent — must support tool-calling for Layer 4 to work.
modelConfig.apiKeyWillClear: Will reset to server/.env on save
